title: Ganowa, farashi da abokan cinikin ku na farko da babu lambar biya

say: Ganowa, farashi, da abokan cinikin ku na farko da babu lambar biya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo na module uku na No-Code App Development.
Masu ginin da suka tsallake bincike suna gina ƙa'idar da abokin ciniki ya bayyana, wanda galibi ba app ɗin da abokin ciniki ke buƙata ba.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
panel.heading: Ginin shine rabin aikin
items: Nemo ainihin tsari da farashin sa
Farashin duk aikin, ba kawai dannawa ba
Juya ayyukan zuwa aikin biya

say: A cikin wannan bidiyon za ku koyi gano ainihin matsalar, farashin aikinku ba tare da rage farashin kanku ba, kuma ku tsara kwanakin 90 na farko na aikin biya.

say: Ganowa shine tattaunawa da lura da kuke yi kafin yin tsokaci. Tambayi ainihin matakai, kuma a karo na ƙarshe ya yi kuskure.

panel.heading: Tambayoyi shida da suka gano ainihin matsalar
items: Yi tafiya da ni cikin abin da ya faru, fara ƙarewa
Ina ba daidai ba? Lokaci na ƙarshe?
Yaya tsawon kowane mataki ya ɗauka, sau nawa?
Wa ya shigar da bayanai, wa ya karanta, wayoyi?
Zan iya ganin littafin rubutu ko takardar da kuke amfani da shi yanzu?
A cikin wata uku, ta yaya za ku san ya yi aiki?

say: Auna lokaci, kuma gano wanda ke amfani da bayanan da kuma waɗanne wayoyi.

say: Misali, Ruth ita ce sakatariyar wata ƙungiyar thrift cooperative a Owerri mai mutane 48. Ta rubuta kowane mako biyan kuɗi daga hotunan kariyar kwamfuta, kusan mintuna 3 kowane memba.

panel.heading: Abin da tsarin Ruth ya kashe a yau
items: Membobi 48 x mintuna 3 = mintuna 144 a mako
2.4 hours x 4 makonni = 9.6 hours
Plus 5 hours sulhu = 14.6 hours
Sau biyu kwata na ƙarshe: wata memba da aka biya ta ce tana bi bashi

say: Wato awanni 2.4 ne a mako, kuma tare da sulhun karshen wata, awanni 14.6 a wata.

say: Kuma sau biyu kwata na karshe, an gaya wa wata memba kuskure cewa ba ta biya ba. Ruth ta fara neman app inda membobin ke shiga. Amma ainihin zafin shine lokacinta da kuma rikice-rikice, wanda ƙaramin app na ciki ke warwarewa.

panel.rule: Auna sa'o'i da kurakurai a yanzu, don haka zaku iya nuna haɓakawa daga baya.

say: Rubuta kowane buƙatu azaman labarin mai amfani: a matsayina na sakatare, Ina so in yi rikodin biyan kuɗi ta zaɓin memba, don haka na daina sake rubuta sunaye. Labarun dole ne su sa app ɗin ya zama mai amfani kwata-kwata.

panel.heading: Tsara labarun mai amfani tare da MoSCoW
items: Dole ne: yin rikodin biyan kuɗi, tuta ba a biya ta ranar Juma'a
Ya kamata: bayanin kowane wata azaman PDF
Zai iya: jadawalin gudummawa
Ba wannan lokacin ba: shiga memba

say: Ya kamata kuma iya labarai na iya biyo baya. Ba yana nufin ba wannan lokacin ba. Sanya duka akan ƙayyadaddun shafi guda ɗaya, kuma sami amincewar abokin ciniki a rubuce, koda ta WhatsApp, kafin ka faɗi farashin ƙarshe.

say: Rarrashin farashi shine kuskuren gama gari, saboda danna cikin editan yana da sauri. Yi ƙididdige kowane lokaci: gano sa'o'i 6, saitin 4, gini 16, gwaji 6, da horo 4. Wato awanni 36 kenan.
Akan naira 10,000 a awa daya, wato naira 360,000 kenan. Ƙara kashi 15 don waɗanda ba a san su ba.

cards.d: An biya ku sau ɗaya, a cikin matakai, don ganowa, gini, gwaji da horo.
Abokin ciniki yana biyan dillali kai tsaye, a ƙarƙashin asusun da abokin ciniki ya mallaka.
Mai riƙewa kowane wata ko tallafin sa'a, bayan ɗan gajeren garanti na kyauta kamar kwanaki 14.

say: Kudin dandamali, wanda abokin ciniki ke biya kai tsaye. Ga jami'ai uku akan Starter, kusan dalar Amurka 15 a wata. Idan kun biya su, app ɗin yana tsayawa ranar da katin ku ya gaza.

say: Rarraba iyaka shine jinkirin haɓaka aikin ta hanyar ƙananan ƙarin buƙatun. Kowanne yana sauti kankani. Tare suke cin ribarku. Na farko, gode wa abokin ciniki kuma duba ƙayyadaddun bayanai.

panel.heading: Karɓar ƙarin buƙatun cikin nutsuwa
items: Godiya ga abokin ciniki
Duba shi bisa ƙayyadaddun bayanai

Tambayi: ƙara shi yanzu, ko mataki na gaba?

say: Idan sababbi ne, kimanta sa'o'i kuma tambaya ko za a ƙara yanzu ko kuma daga baya. Shiga kwanan wata, buƙatun, sa'o'i da yarda, don haka daftari na ƙarshe ba shi da abin mamaki.

say: Misali, Aisha a Kano ta zabi kayan haja da tallace-tallace don shaguna. Ta gina aikace-aikacen demo guda biyu tare da bayanan samfurin da aka yi. Kar a taɓa nuna kwastomomin abokin ciniki na gaske.

panel.heading: Shirin Aisha na aikin biya
items: Makonni 1-4: gina aikace-aikacen demo guda biyu
Makonni 5-8: tuntuɓar shaguna 40, 10 a mako
Nufin tattaunawa 6 da shawarwari 3
Makonni 9-12: nasara da isar da ginin farko

say: Sannan ta tuntubi shaguna 40 ta hanyar ƙungiyar kasuwarta, tana neman tattaunawa ta gano 6 da shawarwari 3.

say: Don tunawa. Dubi aikin kuma auna abin da farashin yake. Rike sigar ɗaya ƙarami. Farashin kowane lokaci. Tsaya farashin guda uku daban. Kuma koyaushe tabbatar da biyan kuɗi a cikin asusun ku.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Kalli aikin kuma auna farashinsa
A ajiye juzu'i na ɗaya zuwa ga labarun Dole
Yi ƙididdige kowane lokaci kuma ƙara rashin tabbas
Raba kuɗin gini, kuɗin dandamali da tallafi
Tabbatar da biyan kuɗi a cikin asusun ku

say: Ayyukanku: gudanar da ƙaramin bincike tare da kasuwanci na gaske, farashi da shi kuma rubuta tsari, sannan gina demo na ku, nazarin shari'a da shirin kwanaki 90.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Gudanar da karamin ganowa
Farashin da ba da shawara
Gina tsarin aikin ku
